posts.cooked:
My random thoughts:
OblivAeon cannot be removed from the game by any alternative means such as Unforgiving Wasteland from the Final Wasteland. You know someone tried this in playtesting and tried to argue they had won because a Skunk Ape had defeated OblivAeon

Rites of Revival stuff: Seems like a better revive now as it sets the hero to max hp the next time they're pulled out of the box. Not sure how many Reward cards a given incapacitated hero will have at one time but it could also be useful to scoop a whole handful at once.

Edit I also love how creepy OblivAeon looks when hes staring at Visionary in The Abyss Stares Back
